pages.text: Dedicated IDE for Long Novels & Scenarios Craft Your World with Structure and Efficiency. Seamless plot-prose synchronization, automatic character reference popups, and human-guided AI agent workflows. A modern writing IDE for authors and engineers. Try in your browser Download Try Nightly (unstable) · Try Web UI · Web UI Nightly (unstable) v0.1.1 released Installation & Setup Guide The browser build needs no installation. The desktop build (Windows / macOS / Linux) and browser build (WebAssembly) share the same layout, the same keys, and open the same project. Published binaries are available in the download section below. novnow v0.1.1 is available Choose your OS and CPU to download a published archive directly. Extract it before running. OS / CPU Desktop CLI / LSP / MCP Windows · x64 Download (GUI) Download (CLI) macOS · Apple Silicon Download (GUI) Download (CLI) macOS · Intel Download (GUI) Download (CLI) Linux · x64 Download (GUI) Download (CLI) Linux · ARM64 Download (GUI) Download (CLI) VSCode VSIX · PyPI · crates.io · SHA256SUMS · Release details pip install novnow==0.1.1 Windows/macOS binaries are unsigned and macOS binaries are not notarized. The extension is distributed as a VSIX, not through Marketplace. Known issues · Installation guide Key Features of NovNow Designed to structure long-form story writing and maximize immersion during creative work. structured-writing 1. Structured Writing (Chapter/Episode/Scene/Section) Break down long novels into Chapters, Episodes, Scenes, and Sections for seamless navigation. Jump instantly using SceneId like '01-04-02-03'. Focus working memory on manageable ~400 word section chunks without losing sight of the epic narrative structure. plot-prose-sync 2. Plot & Prose Synchronization Automatically displays matching scene/section outline summaries and checklists right next to your editor. Keep writing without straying from your outline. Eliminates the friction of toggling back and forth between outline files. auto-reference 3. Automatic Character & World Context Popups Detects characters and terms at the cursor position and renders personality, tone, role language, and lore. Type ' for instant autocomplete of character names and lore terms. Character modes (e.g. A: Normal, B: Combat) adapt per section. centralized-materials 4. Centralized Material Index & Citation Tracking Assigns IDs (M0137/S0042) to research notes, citations, and search snapshots, traceable directly from prose. Append ^M0137 to prose lines to track underlying research sources. Freeze and save search results as standalone research snapshot files. ai-agent-workflow 5. Human-Controlled Gradual AI Agent Workflow Modular AI tasks across 7 distinct roles. Humans set the exact delegation level (off / propose / apply / autonomous). Flexibly delegate tasks: generate ideas while writing prose yourself, or request style reviews. Your human editorial vision always retains full authority. keyboard-first-ui 6. Keyboard-First & 3-Pane Ergonomic Shell Complete keyboard navigation without mouse reliance. Minimalist, label-free dark UI designed for uninterrupted focus. Jump via Ctrl+G , flip between prose and the episode plot with Ctrl+B , switch panes with Ctrl+1/2/3 . Eliminates UI clutter so you can immerse in prose. text-based-data 7. Plain-Text File Format & Project Self-Containment All manuscripts, lore, prompts, and settings saved in readable Markdown/JSON files. Simple file copy moves the entire project. No proprietary database vendor lock-in. Edit files in any text editor, and hit F5 in NovNow to sync external changes seamlessly. layered-architecture 8. Layered Architecture & Language Server Strict architectural decoupling between domain novel logic ( core ) and UI rendering/storage adapters. Ensures lighting-fast performance and crash resiliency, safeguarding your hard-earned manuscript from data corruption. Start with the guide You can start in the browser — nothing to install. Nine steps take you from a blank page to a finished short story. Getting Started (30 min) Guide contents What the guide covers Every guide page on this site is rendered straight from docs/users/. There is one copy to maintain, so the site cannot fall behind. はじめての手引き（30 分で 1 本書き上げる） → Nine steps from blank page to export 早見表 → Sigils and keys on one page 用語集 → What section, mode, and the rest mean よくある質問 → Saving, squiggles, integrations よく出るエラーと直し方（12 件） → Fixing the common squiggles 作品のフォルダ構成 → What is inside a project folder Git で原稿を守る（知りたい人だけ） → For keeping a history 書き出した原稿を公開する → Publishing what you exported Where it runs The layout, the keys, and what gets saved are the same in the browser and on the desktop. pages.title: Diagnostic code reference
pages.text: Diagnostic code reference Find a diagnostic code to see its cause and available action. E001 Error Unknown reference: {0} Cause A reference after ' does not match the dictionary. Available action Register a term or character, or replace it with a suggested match. See example and resolution → E002 Error Malformed structure id Cause A structure ID or explicit reference has invalid syntax. Available action Correct it to a valid structure ID or reference. See example and resolution → E003 Error Mode {1} is not defined for {0} Cause A referenced mode ID has not been defined. Available action Define the mode or choose an existing one. See example and resolution → E004 Error Mode {1} of {0} is not available at {2} (range: {3}) Cause A character mode is used outside its declared range. Available action Extend its range, add a variant, or choose another mode. See example and resolution → E005 Error At most two modes per character in a section Cause A character has more than two modes in a section, or the same character appears twice in its mode field. Available action Keep only the first two modes. See example and resolution → E006 Error Title does not match material {0} Cause The title of a referenced material differs from its index entry. Available action Choose one of the three title correction actions described in section 6.6.3. See example and resolution → E007 Error Material {0} not found Cause The referenced material ID does not exist. Available action Replace it with a nearby ID or create a new material. See example and resolution → E008 Error Duplicate id {0} Cause The same structure ID appears more than once in a file. Available action Renumber the later occurrence. See example and resolution → E012 Error Character {0} is not defined Cause A character named in a speaker tag is undefined. Available action Register that character. See example and resolution → E013 Error Cannot resolve: {0} Cause A relation or another reference cannot be resolved. Available action Replace it with a suggested match. See example and resolution → E016 Error Range start is after range end Cause The start of a range is after its end. Available action Swap the endpoints. See example and resolution → E017 Error Overlapping ranges for mode {0} Cause Two ranges of the same mode ID overlap. Available action Split the ranges. See example and resolution → E018 Error summary is required Cause A plot-outline block has no summary field. Available action Insert an empty summary field. See example and resolution → E020 Error Only level {0} headers are allowed here Cause The heading level does not match the file's expected level. Available action Move the heading to the corresponding file. See example and resolution → E021 Error definition is required Cause An entry in words.md is missing its definition. Available action Insert an empty definition field. See example and resolution → E022 Error This number is reserved: {0} Cause A heading uses a reserved number. pages.title: Feature Guide & Reference
pages.text: NovNow Feature Reference Detailed reference documentation for all core features supporting structured novel writing in NovNow. structured-writing 1. Structured Writing (Chapter/Episode/Scene/Section) Break down long novels into Chapters, Episodes, Scenes, and Sections for seamless navigation. Jump instantly using SceneId like '01-04-02-03'. Focus working memory on manageable ~400 word section chunks without losing sight of the epic narrative structure. plot-prose-sync 2. Plot & Prose Synchronization Automatically displays matching scene/section outline summaries and checklists right next to your editor. Keep writing without straying from your outline. Eliminates the friction of toggling back and forth between outline files. auto-reference 3. Automatic Character & World Context Popups Detects characters and terms at the cursor position and renders personality, tone, role language, and lore. Type ' for instant autocomplete of character names and lore terms. Character modes (e.g. A: Normal, B: Combat) adapt per section. centralized-materials 4. Centralized Material Index & Citation Tracking Assigns IDs (M0137/S0042) to research notes, citations, and search snapshots, traceable directly from prose. Append ^M0137 to prose lines to track underlying research sources. Freeze and save search results as standalone research snapshot files. ai-agent-workflow 5. Human-Controlled Gradual AI Agent Workflow Modular AI tasks across 7 distinct roles. Humans set the exact delegation level (off / propose / apply / autonomous). Flexibly delegate tasks: generate ideas while writing prose yourself, or request style reviews. Your human editorial vision always retains full authority. keyboard-first-ui 6. Keyboard-First & 3-Pane Ergonomic Shell Complete keyboard navigation without mouse reliance. Minimalist, label-free dark UI designed for uninterrupted focus. Jump via Ctrl+G , flip between prose and the episode plot with Ctrl+B , switch panes with Ctrl+1/2/3 . Eliminates UI clutter so you can immerse in prose. text-based-data 7. Plain-Text File Format & Project Self-Containment All manuscripts, lore, prompts, and settings saved in readable Markdown/JSON files. Simple file copy moves the entire project. No proprietary database vendor lock-in. Edit files in any text editor, and hit F5 in NovNow to sync external changes seamlessly. layered-architecture 8. Layered Architecture & Language Server Strict architectural decoupling between domain novel logic ( core ) and UI rendering/storage adapters. Ensures lighting-fast performance and crash resiliency, safeguarding your hard-earned manuscript from data corruption.

pages.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Reference
pages.text: Troubleshooting Reference Reference index for common setup issues, errors, diagnostic alerts, and resolution steps in NovNow. Browse every diagnostic code → Startup & Project Structure Error: 'This directory is not a novnow project' on startup Symptoms & Issue When attempting to open a directory, the GUI does not launch and prints missing file errors to terminal. Root Cause One or more required project files (e.g., project.toml , characters.md , words.md , materials/index.json , plots/all.cnov ) are missing. Resolution Run novnow new . inside the directory to generate boilerplate project files, or create a project using the starter modal. novnow: このディレクトリは novnow プロジェクトではありません 不足しているもの: - project.toml - characters.md - plots/all.cnov Migration Cannot open legacy projects (characters.json detected) Symptoms & Issue Opening a legacy directory results in a legacy format error. Root Cause NovNow v0.1.0 uses characters.md instead of legacy characters.json . Resolution Keep the original project unchanged and use its compatible older release to export plain text. Project format compatibility is not guaranteed before v1, and no v0-to-v1 migration feature will be provided. The CLI migrate command imports prose text into a new project; it does not convert old project formats. Diagnostics & Syntax Red wavy line under character mode (E003 / E004) Symptoms & Issue Error wavy lines appear under mode: fields or speaker annotation @Character:Mode . Root Cause E003 : The mode ID is not defined in characters.md . E004 : Assigned outside the mode's valid SceneId range . Resolution Open quick fix ( Ctrl+. ) to expand the range: in characters.md or replace with an existing defined mode. AI Agent & MCP E030 / E063 / E064 when executing AI tasks Symptoms & Issue AI task execution fails with missing environment variables or unreachable MCP server messages. Root Cause E030 means a missing MCP environment variable; E063 means the MCP server is unreachable; E064 means the local LLM is unreachable. Resolution For MCP, check agents/mcp.json , the required environment variables, and the server process. For a local LLM, check its endpoint in the agent workspace. The browser cannot launch desktop-only stdio servers. Web Version & Storage Web Version: 'Storage is unavailable in this environment' Symptoms & Issue Opening the web version displays a full-screen storage error preventing editor launch. Root Cause IndexedDB access is disabled due to Private/Incognito browsing or browser security settings. Resolution Open NovNow in a standard browsing window, allow storage access, or use the Desktop version. Encoding & UTF-8 Garbled characters or encoding errors after external editing Symptoms & Issue ProjectError::Encoding error prevents opening modified project files. Root Cause An external text editor saved files in Shift_JIS or UTF-16 instead of UTF-8. Resolution Re-open the file in VS Code or any editor, save as UTF-8 (BOM and CRLF are also accepted), and press F5 in NovNow.
